June (Design): Quick check: I'm testing a compact validation surface for the integrations modal. Main tradeoff: show inline errors on blur vs only show a top summary on submit. Also deciding typed-confirm thresholds for destructive actions.
Marco (Product): Hybrid is my vote. Inline for simple field issues, summary for cross-field and server errors. Tone: "Please fix 2 issues to save" reads clear.
Eli (Eng): Hybrid is straightforward. Implementation notes: dedupe identical messages so we don't show the same string in both places. Summary should be focusable (tabindex='-1') and announced (role='alert').
Rae (A11y): Asterisk alone fails with screen readers. Use aria-required on the input and either include "(required)" in the label or a visually-hidden note. Inline errors: aria-live=polite. Summary on submit: aria-live=assertive + focus.
June (DevEx): Microcopy nit: prefer "Please fix X issues to save" tied to the action. For typed-confirm, propose three tiers: low = toast undo (10s), medium = checkbox with explicit count, high = typed-confirm.
Marco (Product): For medium risk, include what will be removed and a required checkbox "I understand this will delete X items". If X > 20, escalate to typed-confirm.
Eli (Eng): Dev questions: typed-confirm default case-insensitive, allowExactMatch flag for exact-case requirement. Recommend cooldownMs after 3 failed attempts to prevent brute-force.
Rae (A11y): Typed-confirm accessibility: link instructions via aria-describedby, make cancel the first tabbable control, and ensure Esc clears/closes the dialog. Also announce typed-confirm instructions for screen readers.
June (Design): Interaction proposal: on blur => show inline hint (polite) without stealing focus; on submit => show summary, focus it, and highlight inline fields. Avoid duplicate language between inline + summary.
notify-bot: Note: adding analytics events: validation.summary_shown, validation.inline_shown, confirm.typed_attempt.
June (Design): I'll push a tiny Figma showing desktop/mobile label density, hybrid validation, and the three confirm patterns. Please review by Friday.
Marco (Product): I'll take copy pass.
Eli (Eng): I'll size and add props: allowExactMatch, cooldownMs, summaryFocusBehavior.
Rae (A11y): I'll run VoiceOver/NVDA checks on the prototype.
June (DevEx): I'll prepare keyboard/a11y checklist for QA.
June (Design): Thanks all :thumbsup:
